set_is_debug: set the debug flag to control whether log messages are printed to stdout
set_log_level: set the minimum log level threshold for filtering which messages get logged to file
print_and_log: log a message to the file logger and optionally print it to stdout based on debug mode
review_logger_config: review the mturk logger configuration including filename, format, and date format settings
summarize_logging_utils: summarize the chat service logging utility module and its global state variables
